test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The pie chart 1 given below shows the runs scored by a player against 6 different countries during 2019-2020. Pie chart 2 shows the runs scored by the same player against the same 6 countries during 2020-2021. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2bc329c4ec52cfa380b059a3025f32124d3e828bfa6346fe8ac8c22a2d46d7a.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1fdbe58e7fe4c39628a2a7a4de19a8500cf2119d5e2cf14f858ef657a437a00.png] 

Find the difference between the total runs scored against New Zealand and Pakistan during 2019-2020 and the total runs scored against Sri Lanka and Pakistan during 2020-2021.
solution:
**Solution:**

Runs scored against New Zealand during 2019-2020 = 14/100 × 4000 = 560 runs

Runs scored against Pakistan during 2019-2020 = 16/100 × 4000 = 640 runs

Total runs scored against New Zealand and Pakistan during 2019-2020 = 560 + 640 = 1200 runs

Runs scored against Sri Lanka during 2020-2021 = 20/100 × 5000 = 1000 runs

Runs scored against Pakistan during 2020-2021 = 15/100 × 5000 = 750 runs

Total runs scored against Sri Lanka and Pakistan during 2020-2021 = 1000 + 750 = 1750 runs

Required difference = 1750 - 1200 = 550 runs

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
